historical_reviews.deepseek: Workload direction is aligned, but its package/evidence/risk come from the duplicate RMA threshold row and materially misstate this measurement workload.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Preserves all eight workloads, 1000 ms PM telemetry and four-rail calculation while adding provenance, limits, abort controls and lossless evidence.
historical_reviews.history: Duplicate row 2090 was directly inspected; EEPROM clearing, poison injection, mode2 reset, CPER and RMA behavior are excluded.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Multi-GPU thermal/power stress requires a dedicated SUT, confirmed mappings and owner-defined safe limits; no automatic retry or fault substitution is allowed.

original_test_intent: Exercise HBM bandwidth concurrently on all eight GPUs, measure the resulting HBM rail power and thermal behavior, calculate the four named HBM rail contributions per GPU/OAM and compare synchronized results with Project limits without GPU errors.
original_method: Verify GPU/OAM and AGT index mappings, begin 1000 ms AGT PM logging, launch the exact hip-stream workload on each of devices 0 through 7, continuously monitor safety and GPU health, then stop cleanly, retain complete raw logs, sum the four rails and graph all data on one time base.
manual_activity: The owner approves the eight-GPU load, topology, rail formulas and safety envelope; an operator supervises aggregate thermal/power conditions and owns emergency stop and recovery.
required_inputs: Exact eight GPU UUID/BDF/OAM/device and AGT index mapping
AGT binary/version/checksum and supported PM groups
Validated hip-stream build/runtime and meaning of 825 Mi elements, 15000 iterations and dot-only
Definitions and units for VDDCR_11_HBM_B/D and VDD_075_HBM_B/D
Per-GPU/OAM and system power/temperature limits plus expected spec range
Synchronized clocks, storage capacity, monitoring/abort controller and recovery path
safety_requirements: Preserve complete pre-run GPU, BMC and OS evidence before any clear
Do not run the duplicate amdgpuras injection, reset RAS EEPROM or collect CPER as acceptance
Verify all device and AGT index mappings instead of assuming numeric indices are stable
Start safety telemetry before workload and keep it complete through cooldown
Abort all workloads on thermal/power limit, GPU reset/offline, XID, ECC/PCIe error, link loss, logger gap or workload failure
Protect credentials and retain full output rather than tails
No automatic retry after an abort
agent_execution_scope: Validate SUT, GPU/OAM mappings, binaries, rail schema and limits
Capture baseline and start time-synchronized AGT, GPU, OS and BMC telemetry
Launch only the approved eight source workloads and record each PID/exit status
Monitor thresholds and terminate the entire load safely on a gate
Stop loggers after cooldown, verify all GPUs and parse complete data
Calculate each four-rail sum and align graphs without issuing the final verdict
engineer_actions: Approve tool artifacts, mappings, expected specification and abort limits
Confirm facility power/thermal headroom and dedicated availability
Supervise stress and recovery from any GPU/system fault
Review calculations, plots and complete logs and own PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: AGT PM logging and eight hip-stream instances match the source, but numeric GPU indices are unverified, remote wrappers expose trust/secrets, tailing hides workload history, and the proposed bad-page/CPER evidence belongs to row 2090.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the verified source AGT command at 1000 ms and the exact hip-stream parameters for all identity-bound GPUs under one monitored controller; preserve full outputs and timestamps for the four-rail analysis.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Eight GPUs, AGT indices 0/5/10/15/20/25/30/35, 1000 ms period, hip-stream devices 0-7, 825*1024*1024 size, 15000 iterations, dot-only, four named rails and 20/10-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind topology, prove telemetry readiness, start all monitoring, execute the eight workloads, enforce aggregate safety stops, cool down, calculate per-OAM HBM power and correlate all raw streams on a common clock.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds immutable tool/topology identity, measurable limits, coordinated process control, complete evidence and explicit removal of unrelated RAS injection.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Fault-injection CPER or isolated GPU activity cannot replace simultaneous eight-GPU HBM workload and four-rail PM measurements.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Combined HBM traffic can saturate shared cooling/power and trigger GPU reset or system instability; AGT sampling and rail labels must be vendor-valid for calculated values to be meaningful.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC must provide numerical or categorical `meet spec` limits and approve any different topology or rail names. Reducing GPU concurrency, iterations or data size is a disclosed coverage reduction, not an equivalent pass.
expected_evidence: SUT and eight GPU UUID/BDF/OAM/device/AGT mapping, firmware/driver and tool artifact identities
Approved rail formula, units, Project limits, aggregate power/thermal headroom and abort matrix
Complete 1000 ms AGT PM data and full per-GPU hip-stream stdout/stderr/exit status
Continuous temperature, power, clock, XGMI, ECC/PCIe/XID, BMC/OS events and abort history
Per-GPU/OAM four-rail calculations and synchronized common-axis workload/power/thermal graphs
Cooldown/final GPU health, no-injection audit, spec comparison and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Row 1531 consistently specifies eight-GPU HBM stress, AGT measurement and four-rail analysis. The vague `meet spec` criterion is a required Project oracle, while duplicate row 2090 and DeepSeek RAS content are separable identity/association defects.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Tool artifacts, topology, rail schema and limits are finite vendor/Project inputs. They gate execution but do not make the source workload or intended comparison indeterminate.

review_improvement: Corrects the copied RAS-injection evidence, preserves every workload and telemetry parameter, and turns a high-power eight-GPU run into a topology-bound, continuously monitored rail-analysis contract.
independent_technical_reasoning: Four-rail sums are valid only when each telemetry channel is mapped to the same physical OAM as its workload and sampled on a comparable timeline. Launching eight numeric device indices without identity binding can stress one topology while attributing power to another, producing convincing but invalid graphs.
